hypotheses.persona: Traditional morning reader with outdoor leisure habits
hypotheses.rationale: Reading glasses appearing at the table and then moving to the patio table strongly confirms the 'reader' aspect of the morning routine. The persistence of this specific object movement pattern across weekdays and weekends solidifies the 'established habit' theory. No work-related items (laptop, documents) have been observed in 7 days.

Still possible if work is done off-site or on mobile devices not tracked. However, the complete absence of any work-related objects (laptop, notebooks, phones left on desks) for a full week makes this increasingly unlikely compared to the reader hypothesis.

The consistency of the morning ritual (coffee, reading) across 7 days, including the weekend, strongly suggests residency. A guest is unlikely to maintain such a rigid, identical schedule for a full week.
